acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Show the product going on and the finished look in one short ad. Keep the result true to what customers can expect.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Add your real price, code, and shade name to the ad. Review the words before posting so the offer matches your shop.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Finished beauty ads have no watermark and can be used commercially. Keep product claims and prices accurate before publishing.
